# AU Accounting Services

> Professional accounting, tax, payroll, and business advisory practice
> based in Potchefstroom, North West, South Africa, trading as AU Services
> (Pty) Ltd. Operates under the brand "The Golden Standard."

## What we do
- Body corporates & homeowners associations — accounting and compliance
- Annual financial statements (compilations)
- Tax & compliance
- Bookkeeping
- Payroll
- Business advisory

## Credentials
- Professional Accountant (SA)
- SARS Registered Tax Practitioner
- Compiled under ISRS 4410 (Revised) and International Financial Reporting
  Standards

## Where we work
Based in Potchefstroom, North West, South Africa. Serves clients across
South Africa.

## Hours
Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00.
